   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      4 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 15.06.2026 - 13.08.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Gumball Kara_, 04.07.2026, 1/5: "The app keeps crashing without any warnings. I’ve uninstalled, installed and updated the app but I am still unable to open it on my iPhone 11."
            2. _Oyyun_, 06.07.2026, 3/5: "I used to use this all the time but now I can't even open the app. I've even tried uninstalling and reinstalling, but it still crashes on open. Back to using Apple Reminders I guess"
            3. _DubV23_, 13.08.2026, 4/5: "Good tasks lists with no frills but a buggy widget that list the color code with the list title. I wish the widget could be made one size larger and that widget would allow you to see just the scheduled tasks despite which list they are in."
